description: imap/src/session/mailbox.rs glob_match() implements RFC 3501 LIST wildcard matching with an O(m×n) dynamic-programming matcher. A MAX_GLOB_BYTES=1024 guard rejects oversized patterns before the DP table is allocated. This correctly prevents a crafted LIST pattern from causing excessive memory or CPU use. The approach is sound: the guard is applied before any allocation, the DP table size is bounded by 1024×mailbox_name_len, and the function returns false (no match) for oversized input rather than an error that could leak information.
title: decision: IMAP glob_match uses bounded DP with MAX_GLOB_BYTES=1024 guard
